title: Amex GBT Completes Acquisition of CWT
summary: Welcoming CWT customers to Amex GBT will unlock unrivaled choice, value and experiences. Transaction expected to create significant shareholder value with approximately $155 million of annual run-rate identified synergies within 3 years. American Express Global Business Travel, which is operated by Global Business Travel Group, Inc. (NYSE: GBTG) (“Amex GBT” or the “Company”), a leading software and services company for travel, expense and meetings events, today announced that it has completed its acquisition of CWT, a global business travel and meetings solutions provider. The transaction, originally announced in March 2024, values CWT at approximately $540 million on a cash-free, debt-free basis, subject to certain assumptions and purchase price adjustments. With the close of the acquisition, Amex GBT welcomes CWT’s customers and employees to its leading software solutions and services for travel, expense, meetings and events.
